title: Re-evaluating LLM-based Heuristic Search: A Case Study on the 3D Packing Problem

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the source code of LLM-generated heuristics across evolutionary search generations to observe the model's tendency to default to familiar, pre-trained algorithmic structures (e.g., basic greedy 'largest-item-first' approaches) rather than inventing fundamentally novel algorithmic paradigms.
